scope.computed_from: Frozen v1 train/validation labels, legal masks, history and source code only. No test metric was used to select weights, thresholds or design settings.

actual_reconstruction_reset_options.decks: per-game globally constrained opening, see sequence metadata
actual_reconstruction_reset_options.forms: all base hypothesis; source forms remain unknown

diagnosis.conclusion: 未发现损失权重漏乘、掩码错杀合法teacher动作、槽位索引偏移或GRU跨局串线。现有加权多类CE与逐类argmax可以合理产生全WAIT；这是目标/解码结构与弱时间监督的限制，不能仅凭全WAIT推定实现错误。
diagnosis.static_mass_caveat: 39.886%是训练标签按cap8加权后、排除强制WAIT的静态非WAIT权重质量近似，不是模型实测概率或校准后的出牌率。每批独立归一化、状态特征、合法动作掩码与数据分布都会改变条件后验。
diagnosis.prior_illustration: 无区分特征的常数预测近似中，约60.1%的WAIT质量集中在一个类别，约39.9%的非WAIT质量分散于4个手牌槽；因此每槽可能均小于WAIT，而非WAIT总概率仍非零。该近似不等于实际网络输出。
diagnosis.slot_imbalance_finding: 训练4槽目标489/475/500/534，未见某槽缺失或严重失衡；1608/1998个出牌标签有4个合法非WAIT选项。
diagnosis.learning_evidence: 4个epoch的加权card loss下降、验证位置NLL下降、梯度范数非零；验证argmax非WAIT数每轮仍为0，支持模型在学习位置但未形成可触发的逐类argmax。

code_review.finding: card CE仅取label_valid；非WAIT权重确实乘8后除以同批weight.sum，公式实现一致。它是每批加权均值，不是全数据全局分母，也不直接保证非WAIT整体argmax。
位置loss仅部署1..4，按真实teacher手牌槽gather，并以位置标签数单独取均值；没有WAIT位置损失，也没有能力按钮位置损失。
合法card mask与位置可行性结合；WAIT始终合法，空位置槽有dummy位置但对应card概率为零；未见softmax全负无穷或合法teacher被掩码的路径。
每lane新局重置hidden，chunk间detach，padding无loss，下局前丢弃padding memory；未见跨局/跨seat状态混用。
验证选模用未加权card NLL加单独位置NLL，而训练用加权card CE；两者目标并不完全一致，但配置与实现均已预声明，不是运行时漏权重。
全局未来出牌约束选初手/队列，属于hindsight条件的反事实模拟重建；不能宣称原始因果实战观察或官方状态真值。
最终冻结checkpoint顶层reconstruction_reset_options已非空且与dataset_provenance一致；早期空字段快照已不适用。

next_round_design_proposal.status: design_only; do not alter v1 or select using frozen test/96-game suite results
next_round_design_proposal.hardware: CPU only, at most2 worker/torch threads; retain current public observation encoder and GRU. Added event/conditional heads are small and require no GPU.

factorization.q: q_t=P(nonWAIT|public history); force q_t=0 if no nonWAIT action is legal.
factorization.conditional_action: r_t(j)=masked softmax over legal nonWAIT actions j=1..7 (4 deploy slots plus available ability buttons).
factorization.joint_probability: P(WAIT)=1-q_t; P(action=j)=q_t*r_t(j); a deployment additionally uses P(position|j,history).
factorization.important_limit: Factorization alone does not guarantee nonWAIT under joint MAP. Greedy WAIT may still be Bayes-optimal for uncertain timing. Keep probabilistic cadence/sampling and joint-vs-hierarchical decoding explicitly distinct, predeclare the decoder before held-out evaluation.

losses.event: Binary event likelihood over valid choice timesteps; report forced-WAIT timesteps separately. If cost weighting or resampling is used, derive it only from train data and document probability recalibration on validation.
losses.conditional_card: Cross entropy over the actual nonWAIT class on qualified nonWAIT labels; legality mask retained.
losses.position: Conditional location loss only on qualified deployment labels; report its normalization and coefficient separately from timing.
losses.normalization: State explicitly whether head losses are per-event/per-frame/per-batch or one per-valid-frame joint NLL. Current separate mean losses are a valid multiobjective choice but do not equal a single calibrated joint-action NLL.
losses.unknown_abilities: v1 contains0 qualified ability labels; do not claim the ability head learned expert timing. Obtain separately qualified ability supervision or describe the head as unsupported by this dataset.

next_round_design_proposal.recurrent_sampling: Retain every chronological observation and invalid gap before supervised labels. Loss reweighting/downsampling must not remove history rows or compress elapsed time; keep whole-game/seat hidden resets and TBPTT detachment.
train_validation_diagnostics: Event NLL/Brier/calibration and nonWAIT mass on choice frames, separate forced WAIT.
Event precision/recall and stochastic cadence on train/validation; slot accuracy conditional on true nonWAIT.
Conditional position distance/NLL and joint action likelihood; report all-WAIT and simple event-prior baselines.
One small train-only overfit/gradient-path diagnostic can distinguish optimization failure from irreducible timing ambiguity; it is a contract diagnostic, not strength evidence.
If component interference is suspected, measure train-batch gradient norms by objective before changing coefficients.
next_round_design_proposal.experiment_control: Predeclare a small CPU-feasible variant set and fixed training budget; keep old v1 split grouping/holdout boundaries, deduplicate expanded data by whole battle, and reserve a new untouched strength suite if the old suite has informed designs. Choose weights/thresholds only using train/validation, freeze the selected checkpoint, then evaluate held-out games once.
next_round_design_proposal.data_boundary: More archive coverage does not resolve unknown original build/forms/RNG/initial hand or hindsight opening selection. Keep counterfactual provenance and first-divergence masks.

publication_review.clean_minimal_numpy_engine_validation: previously verified on both backends; full Torch-enabled clean Actions execution is not claimed by this static audit
